references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 0
references.quote: (a) General Rule – Three Years. Except as provided in subsections (b) , (c) , (d) , (e) , (f) and (g) of this section, any person who has been convicted of a violation of an ordinance or has satisfied the terms of a diversion agreement may petition the Municipal Court for the expungement of such conviction, diversion and related arrest records if the following conditions are met:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 1
references.quote: (1) All assessed costs, fees and fines have been paid in full; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 2
references.quote: (2) Three or more years have elapsed since the later of any of the following events:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 3
references.quote: (i) Completion of diversion;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 4
references.quote: (ii) Pronouncement of sentence; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 5
references.quote: (iii) Discharged from probation, parole or incarceration.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 6
references.quote: (b) Exception – Knives – No Waiting Period. Any person convicted of a violation of any ordinance that is prohibited by K.S.A. 12-16,134 (a) or (b) and amendments thereto, and which was adopted prior to July 1, 2014, or who entered into a diversion agreement in lieu of further criminal proceedings for such violation, may petition the court for the expungement of such conviction or diversion agreement and related arrest records.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 7
references.quote: (c) Exception – Selling Sexual Relations – One-Year Waiting Period. Any person convicted of the violation of an ordinance which would also constitute a violation of K.S.A. 21-3512 , prior to its repeal, or a violation of K.S.A. 21-6419 , and amendments thereto, or who entered into a diversion agreement in lieu of further criminal proceedings for such violation, may petition the Municipal Court for the expungement of such conviction or diversion agreement and related arrest records if the following conditions are met:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 8
references.quote: (1) All assessed costs, fees and fines have been paid in full; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 9
references.quote: (2) One or more years have elapsed since the later of any of the following events:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 10
references.quote: (i) Completion of diversion;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 11
references.quote: (ii) Pronouncement of sentence; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 12
references.quote: (iii) Discharge from probation, parole or incarceration; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 13
references.quote: (3) Such person can prove they were acting under coercion caused by the act of another. For purposes of this section, “coercion” means: threats of harm or physical restraint against any person; a scheme, plan or pattern intended to cause a person to believe that failure to perform an act would result in bodily harm or physical restraint against any person; or the abuse or threatened abuse of the legal process.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 14
references.quote: (d) Exception – Motor Vehicle Related – Five Years. No person may petition for expungement of a conviction or a diversion agreement and related arrest records for any of the ordinance violations that would also constitute the crimes identified in subsection (d)(3) of this section until the conditions in subsections (d)(1) and (d)(2) of this section have been met:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 15
references.quote: (1) All assessed costs, fees and fines have been paid in full; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 16
references.quote: (2) Five or more years have elapsed since the later of any of the following events:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 17
references.quote: (i) Completion of diversion;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 18
references.quote: (ii) Pronouncement of sentence; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 19
references.quote: (iii) Discharge from probation, parole or incarceration.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 20
references.quote: (3) Crimes.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 21
references.quote: (i) Vehicular homicide, as defined by K.S.A. 21-3405 , prior to its repeal, or K.S.A. 21-5406 , and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 22
references.quote: (ii) Driving while the privilege to operate a motor vehicle on the public highways of this State has been canceled, suspended or revoked, as prohibited by K.S.A. 8-262 , and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 23
references.quote: (iii) Perjury resulting from a violation of K.S.A. 8-261a , and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 24
references.quote: (iv) A violation of the provisions of the fifth clause of K.S.A. 8-142 , and amendments thereto, relating to fraudulent applications;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 25
references.quote: (v) Any crime punishable as a felony wherein a motor vehicle was used in the perpetration of such crime;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 26
references.quote: (vi) Failing to stop at the scene of an accident and perform the duties required by K.S.A. 8-1602 , 8-1603 , prior to its repeal, or 8-1604 , and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 27
references.quote: (vii) A violation of the provisions of K.S.A. 40-3104 , and amendments thereto, relating to motor vehicle liability insurance coverage; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 28
references.quote: (viii) A violation of K.S.A. 21-3405b , prior to its repeal.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 29
references.quote: (e) Exception – Driving under the Influence, First Violation – Five Years. No person may petition for expungement of a conviction or a diversion agreement and related arrest records for a first violation of an ordinance which would also constitute a first violation of K.S.A. 8-1567 or 8-1025 and amendments thereto until the following conditions have been met:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 30
references.quote: (1) All assessed costs, fees and fines have been paid in full; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 31
references.quote: (2) Five or more years have elapsed since the later of any of the following events:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 32
references.quote: (i) Completion of diversion;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 33
references.quote: (ii) Pronouncement of sentence; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 34
references.quote: (iii) Discharge from probation, parole or incarceration.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 35
references.quote: (f) Exception – Driving under the Influence, Second and Subsequent Violations – Ten Years. No person may petition for expungement of a conviction or diversion agreement and related arrest records for a second or subsequent violation of an ordinance which would also constitute a second or subsequent violation of K.S.A. 8-1567 or 8-1025 and amendments thereto until the following conditions are met:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 36
references.quote: (1) All assessed costs, fees and fines have been paid in full; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 37
references.quote: (2) Ten or more years have elapsed since the later of any of the following events:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 38
references.quote: (i) Completion of diversion;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 39
references.quote: (ii) Pronouncement of sentence; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 40
references.quote: (iii) Discharge from probation, parole or incarceration.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 41
references.quote: (g) Exception – Driving under the Influence – Commercial Vehicles. There shall be no expungement of convictions or diversion for a violation of an ordinance which would also constitute a violation of K.S.A. 8-2144 and amendments thereto.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 42
references.quote: (h) Petition. When a petition for expungement is filed, the court shall set a date for a hearing thereon and shall give notice thereof to the prosecuting attorney. The petition shall state: (1) the defendant’s full name; (2) the full name of the defendant at the time of arrest, conviction or diversion, if different from the defendant’s current name; (3) the defendant’s sex, race, and date of birth; (4) the crime for which the defendant was arrested, convicted, or diverted; (5) the date of the defendant’s arrest, conviction, or diversion; (6) an acknowledgement that all assessed costs, fees and fines associated with the conviction or diversion agreement sought to be expunged have been paid; and (7) the identity of the convicting court, arresting law enforcement agency or diverting authority. The Municipal Court may prescribe a fee to be charged as costs for a person petitioning for an order of expungement pursuant to this section. Any person who may have relevant information about the petitioner may testify at the hearing. The court may inquire into the background of the petitioner and shall have access to any reports or records relating to the petitioner that are on file with the Secretary of Corrections or the prisoner review board.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 43
references.quote: (i) Hearing. At the hearing on the petition, the court shall order the petitioner’s arrest record, conviction, or diversion expunged if the court finds that:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 44
references.quote: (1) The petitioner has not been convicted of a felony in the past two years and no proceeding involving any such crime is presently pending or being instituted against the petitioner;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 45
references.quote: (2) The circumstances and behavior of the petitioner warrant the expungement; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 46
references.quote: (3) The expungement is consistent with the public welfare; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 47
references.quote: (4) All assessed costs, fees and fines associated with the conviction or diversion agreement sought to be expunged have been paid.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 48
references.quote: (j) Expungement Order – Notification – Effect of Order – Nondisclosure Exceptions. When the court has ordered an arrest record, conviction or diversion expunged, the order of expungement shall state the information required to be contained in the petition. The clerk of the court shall send a certified copy of the order of expungement to the Kansas Bureau of Investigation which shall notify the Federal Bureau of Investigation, the Secretary of Corrections and any other criminal justice agency which may have a record of the arrest, conviction, or diversion. If the case was appealed from Municipal Court, the clerk of the district court shall send a certified copy of the order of expungement to the Municipal Court. The Municipal Court shall order the case expunged once the certified copy of the order of expungement is received. After the order of expungement is entered, the petitioner shall be treated as not having been arrested, convicted or diverted of the crime, except that:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 49
references.quote: (1) Upon conviction for any subsequent crime, the conviction that was expunged may be considered as a prior conviction in determining the sentence to be imposed;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 50
references.quote: (2) The petitioner shall disclose that the arrest, conviction, or diversion occurred if asked about previous arrests, convictions, or diversions:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 51
references.quote: (i) In any application for licensure as a private detective, private detective agency, certification as a firearms trainer pursuant to K.S.A. 75-7b21 , and amendments thereto, or employment as a detective with a private detective agency, as defined by K.S.A. 75-7b01 , and amendments thereto; as security personnel with a private patrol operator, as defined by K.S.A. 75-7b01 , and amendments thereto; or with an institution, as defined in K.S.A. 76-12a01 , and amendments thereto, of the Department for Aging and Disability Services;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 52
references.quote: (ii) In any application for admission, or for an order of reinstatement, to the practice of law in this State;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 53
references.quote: (iii) To aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications for employment with the Kansas Lottery or for work in sensitive areas within the Kansas Lottery as deemed appropriate by the Executive Director of the Kansas Lottery;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 54
references.quote: (iv) To aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications for Executive Director of the Kansas Racing and Gaming Commission, for employment with the Commission or for work in sensitive areas in parimutuel racing as deemed appropriate by the Executive Director of the Commission, or to aid in determining qualifications for licensure or renewal of licensure by the Commission;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 55
references.quote: (v) To aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications for the following under the Kansas Expanded Lottery Act:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 56
references.quote: (A) Lottery gaming facility manager or prospective manager, racetrack gaming facility manager or prospective manager, licensee or certificate holder; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 57
references.quote: (B) An officer, director, employee, owner, agent or contractor thereof;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 58
references.quote: (vi) Upon application for a commercial driver’s license under K.S.A. 8-2125 through 8-2142 , and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 59
references.quote: (vii) To aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications to be an employee of the State Gaming Agency;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 60
references.quote: (viii) To aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications to be an employee of a tribal gaming commission or to hold a license issued pursuant to a tribal-state gaming compact;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 61
references.quote: (ix) In any application for registration as a broker-dealer, agent, investment adviser or investment adviser representative, all as defined in K.S.A. 17-12a102 and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 62
references.quote: (x) In any application for employment as a law enforcement officer, as defined in K.S.A. 22-2202 or 74-5602 , and amendments thereto;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 63
references.quote: (xi) For applications to aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications for a license to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to the Personal and Family Protection Act, K.S.A. 75-7c01 et seq. and amendments thereto; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 64
references.quote: (xii) For applications received on and after July 1, 2016, to aid in determining the petitioner’s qualifications for a license issued by the Kansas Attorney General to act as a bail enforcement agent;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 65
references.quote: (3) The court, in the order of expungement, may specify other circumstances under which the arrest, conviction or diversion is to be disclosed; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 66
references.quote: (4) The conviction may be disclosed in a subsequent prosecution for an offense which requires as an element of such offense a prior conviction of the type expunged.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 67
references.quote: (k) Notification of Expungement Opportunity. Whenever a person is convicted of an ordinance violation, pleads guilty and pays a fine for such a violation, is placed on parole or probation or is granted a suspended sentence for such a violation, the person shall be informed of the ability to expunge the arrest records or conviction. Whenever a person enters into a diversion agreement, the person shall be informed of the ability to expunge the diversion.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 68
references.quote: (l) Employment/License Application. Subject to the disclosures required pursuant to subsection (j) of this section, in any application for employment, license or other civil right or privilege, or any appearance as a witness, a person whose arrest records, conviction, or diversion of an offense has been expunged may state that such person has never been arrested, convicted, or diverted of such offense.

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 69
references.quote: (m) Disclosure of Records Related to Expungement. Whenever the record of any arrest, conviction, or diversion has been expunged, the custodian of the records of arrest, conviction, diversion and incarceration relating to that crime shall not disclose the existence of such records, except when requested by:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 70
references.quote: (1) The person whose record was expunged;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 71
references.quote: (2) A private detective agency or a private patrol operator, as defined by K.S.A. 75-7b01 , and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made in conjunction with an application for employment with such agency or operator by the person whose record has been expunged;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 72
references.quote: (3) A court, upon a showing of a subsequent conviction of the person whose record has been expunged;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 73
references.quote: (4) The Secretary of the Department for Aging and Disability Services, or a designee of the Secretary, for the purpose of obtaining information relating to employment in an institution, as defined in K.S.A. 76-12a01 , and amendments thereto, of the Department for Aging and Disability Services of any person whose record has been expunged;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 74
references.quote: (5) A person entitled to such information pursuant to the terms of the expungement order;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 75
references.quote: (6) A prosecuting attorney, and such request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made in conjunction with a prosecution of an offense that requires a prior conviction as one of the elements of such offense;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 76
references.quote: (7) The Supreme Court, the clerk or disciplinary administrator thereof, the State Board for Admission of Attorneys or the State Board for Discipline of Attorneys, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made in conjunction with an application for admission, or for an order of reinstatement, to the practice of law in this State by the person whose record has been expunged;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 77
references.quote: (8) The Kansas Lottery, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining qualifications for employment with the Kansas Lottery or for work in sensitive areas within the Kansas Lottery as deemed appropriate by the Executive Director of the Kansas Lottery;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 78
references.quote: (9) The Governor or the Kansas Racing and Gaming Commission, or a designee of the Commission, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining qualifications for Executive Director of the Commission, for employment with the Commission, for work in sensitive areas in parimutuel racing as deemed appropriate by the Executive Director of the Commission or for licensure, renewal of licensure or continued licensure by the Commission;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 79
references.quote: (10) The Kansas Racing and Gaming Commission, or a designee of the Commission, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining qualifications of the following under the Kansas Expanded Lottery Act:

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 80
references.quote: (i) Lottery gaming facility managers and prospective managers, racetrack gaming facility managers and prospective managers, licensees and certificate holders; and

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 81
references.quote: (ii) Their officers, directors, employees, owners, agents and contractors;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 82
references.quote: (11) The State Gaming Agency, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining qualifications: (i) to be an employee of the State Gaming Agency; or (ii) to be an employee of a tribal gaming commission or to hold a license issued pursuant to a tribal-state gaming compact;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 83
references.quote: (12) The Kansas Securities Commissioner, or a designee of the Commissioner, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made in conjunction with an application for registration as a broker-dealer, agent, investment adviser or investment adviser representative by such agency and the application was submitted by the person whose record has been expunged;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 84
references.quote: (13) The Attorney General, and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining qualifications for a license to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to the Personal and Family Protection Act or a license to act as a bail enforcement agent;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 85
references.quote: (14) The Kansas Sentencing Commission;

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 86
references.quote: (15) The Kansas Commission on Peace Officers’ Standards and Training and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining certification eligibility for employment as a law enforcement officer; or

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 87
references.quote: (16) A law enforcement agency and the request is accompanied by a statement that the request is being made to aid in determining eligibility for employment as a law enforcement officer. (Ord. 20206 § 9, 9-10-19; Ord. 20027 § 1, 10-4-16. Formerly 2.110.660.)

references.label: TMC 2.40.660 block 88
references.quote: State Law References: Similar State statute, K.S.A. 12-4516 .
